limitations: Finite synthetic query measurements; no production-weighted, concurrent, live-provider or physical ARM throughput claim.
Only instant one-operation literal roots over admitted ordinary Float folds are accelerated. Range, modified-clock, dynamic/nested and surviving native results retain general preparation.
No claim that every possible mixed-descriptor fallback has identical work; the measured finite panel is nonincreasing.
C results are inspected after query release while the report remains alive; broader ownership coverage is retained separately.
The unit arithmetic helper is not an independent numerical oracle; complete expressions are independently compared with captured Go outcomes.
